titleEn: Maximum Bags With Full Capacity of Rocks
title: 装满石头的背包的最大数量
summary: 每个背包有容量和已有石头，可分配 additionalRocks 使尽量多背包装满，求最大数量。
insight: 每包装满所需 deficit=capacity-rocks。为最大化数量，按 deficit 升序依次填满，预算不足时停止。
pitfalls: 已满背包 deficit 为零自动计入

solutions.title: 排序缺口贪心
solutions.idea: 优先完成花费最少的背包。
steps: 计算 deficits 数组并排序
若 deficit<=remaining，扣除并 answer++，否则 break

code.java: class Solution { public int maximumBags(int[] capacity,int[] rocks,int additionalRocks){int[] deficits=new int[capacity.length];for(int i=0;i<capacity.length;i++)deficits[i]=capacity[i]-rocks[i];Arrays.sort(deficits);int answer=0;for(int deficit:deficits){if(deficit>additionalRocks)break;additionalRocks-=deficit;answer++;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maximumBags(capacity:IntArray,rocks:IntArray,additionalRocksValue:Int):Int{val deficits=IntArray(capacity.size){capacity[it]-rocks[it]};deficits.sort();var remaining=additionalRocksValue;var answer=0;for(deficit in deficits){if(deficit>remaining)break;remaining-=deficit;answer++};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int maximumBags(vector<int>& capacity,vector<int>& rocks,int additionalRocks){vector<int> deficits(capacity.size());for(int i=0;i<(int)capacity.size();++i)deficits[i]=capacity[i]-rocks[i];sort(deficits.begin(),deficits.end());int answer=0;for(int deficit:deficits){if(deficit>additionalRocks)break;additionalRocks-=deficit;++answer;}return answer;} };
